description: This file is a shell script that manages the restart process of the OpenClaw application on macOS. It handles steps such as killing existing instances, rebuilding, signing, packaging, and launching the app, as well as managing launch agents and ensuring the app is running correctly.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Logs messages to standard output, with arguments formatted as a string.

methods.name: fail
methods.description: Logs an error message to stderr and exits the script with a non-zero status.

methods.name: run_step
methods.description: Executes a command with a label, logging the step and handling failure.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Removes the lock directory during cleanup.

methods.name: acquire_lock
methods.description: Creates a lock directory to prevent concurrent restarts, waiting if necessary.

methods.name: check_signing_keys
methods.description: Checks for available code signing identities using security command.

methods.name: kill_all_openclaw
methods.description: Kills all running instances of the OpenClaw application.

methods.name: stop_launch_agent
methods.description: Stops the launch agent for OpenClaw.
